name: application-sankey-flow-diagram
title: Sankey Flow Diagram
description: A node-and-flow visualization that traces weighted paths across stages — e.g. traffic source through funnel stage to outcome — using proportionally sized ribbons.
useWhen: Visualizing how a quantity splits and recombines across multiple stages, such as traffic source through conversion outcome.
The relative proportion of each path (not just each stage total) is the point — ribbon width encodes flow volume.
avoidWhen: You only need stage-over-stage drop-off without tracing which upstream source contributed — use `Funnel Chart` instead.
There are more than 3-4 stages or many nodes per stage — a Sankey gets visually tangled past that; consider a table breakdown instead.
responsiveBehavior: The diagram is a single SVG with viewBox scaling that shrinks proportionally with its container; below roughly 400px width, node labels will crowd and should be hidden or moved to a tooltip.
accessibility: Each node's label and value are rendered as real text elements, not embedded in the SVG as unlabeled shapes.
Ribbon color is tied to its source node's color and is a secondary cue — the node labels and values are the primary source of truth.
Provide a text or table fallback of the same flow data for screen reader users, since the ribbon geometry itself does not convey magnitude non-visually.

variants.title: Three-column flow
variants.description: A signup funnel by traffic source: two sources flow into two mid-stage outcomes, which flow into three final outcomes, all as proportionally weighted ribbons.
accessibility: Every node shows its label and numeric value as text directly beside its bar.

variants.title: Three-column flow (Dark)
variants.description: Three-column Sankey flow adapted for dark surfaces, with node and ribbon colors re-tuned for dark contrast.
accessibility: Node colors and ribbon fills meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark card background; label text uses a light gray, not pure node color.
